title: Map Boğaziçi PMR role targets
acceptance_criteria: Public professional/institutional contact surfaces are mapped only for role routing, with no claim of interview completion or endorsement
Food Services, current contractor, BİD, sustainability/Zero Waste, SKS escalation and operational support roles are distinguished
Each target has a narrow set of research questions tied to unresolved product assumptions
Recommended interview order minimizes generic outreach and prioritizes quantity ownership, freeze time, settlement and data access
The map explicitly prohibits requesting personal diner data and treats aggregate privacy-safe access as the desired boundary
A machine-readable companion supports IE/CS2 agents without converting contact data into evidence
notes: Public role/contact mapping only; no outreach or interview has been performed by this task.
Direct public contacts are used only where published by the organization; no private/personal contact data are collected.
Does not touch KREATE/EVIDENCE.md, KREATE/ASSUMPTIONS.md or interview tracker files.
